children: Varys Capital and Verda Ventures published a 70-page report, LATAM: Beyond the Acronym — Disaggregating Technological & Financial Investment Opportunities Across Latin America, arguing the region should be viewed as four market archetypes rather than one destination. According to BeInCrypto, the study says fragmentation across purchasing power, regulation, financial access and digital infrastructure is itself an investment signal, while stablecoins and digital dollars are increasingly used for savings, payments, remittances and treasury management.

title: Varys Capital, Verda Ventures Map Four LATAM Investment Archetypes
